title: Declare and record custom span fields
brief: A custom field value and its declaration are separate inputs. Tracing fixes a span's field set at creation.

choices.choose_when: Custom metadata belongs on instrumented node spans
choices.tradeoff: The key must exist in the macro-created field set.

choices.choose_when: Metadata belongs on the parent operation
choices.tradeoff: Backend presentation of parent attributes is distinct from copying them to children.

claims.statement: add_custom_field inserts a value into the options map; it does not add a new field to a span after creation.
InstrumentationOptions also exposes custom_fields publicly; a struct literal can supply a map. The builder is a convenience, not the only way to configure values.
The declared query_id field receives its configured value; an undeclared key is absent on the execution spans. The comparison also isolates metrics enablement.

implementation: Declare env = tracing::field::Empty in the macro and set env in the options.
Distinguish span metadata name/target from exported otel.name and other attributes.
unknowns: No assumption that arbitrary dynamic keys are exportable or inherited by child spans.
